role: citizen committee supporting Buffalo-Amherst rail rapid transit project
stance_basis: committee formed specifically to support local efforts toward a favorable decision on the Buffalo-Amherst rail rapid transit project
summary: The Committee for Federal Action was a 50-member citizens' committee appointed in July 1975 by the New York State Transportation Commissioner to support local efforts directed toward a favorable federal decision on the Buffalo-Amherst rail rapid transit project. Its membership was drawn from a cross section of the area's business, civic, labor, and community leaders, indicating broad-based community support for the project.
